model_input: one polarity-separated event-count frame per sample
split_strategy: within each target visible fragment, consecutive complete windows are partitioned into local blocks of about six; every splittable block gets one validation and one test window, with the rest train
closed_core_rule: remove only frame-confirmed fully closed cores using midpoints to the adjacent visible frames; windows never cross the resulting gap
tail_rule: discard every residual fragment tail shorter than 400 events before split assignment; no tail-backfill candidate is created
stride_rule: add one start+200 train window only between consecutive complete train windows in the same visible fragment
